Q5217.reason: Under UCC 2-207 an acceptance expressly conditioned on the new loading charge is a counteroffer, and nothing shows that counteroffer was accepted.

Q8260.reason: Water is formed only when oxygen accepts electrons at the end of the chain, so it stops at once while glycolysis still yields pyruvate and some ATP.

Q5585.reason: The question suggests its own answer and is asked on direct of the calling party’s own witness, so it is an improper leading question unless the witness is hostile or adverse.
